notes: The author self-declares a grand theft auto type game, which is Open World Action, and nothing they describe contradicts that - free roam with walking NPCs is the foundation of that game rather than a different one, so I did not downgrade this to No Genre just because the first build has no combat yet. Shape is world-open: a few connected gritty city blocks crossed in whatever order the player likes. I started from the Open World Action preset but ended up at none, because its arena-stacked shape and its combat options both contradict the brief - cover pillars and chokepoints would put fight geometry into a street the author explicitly wants for free roam and pedestrians, and the wrong option is an instruction to the image model rather than something inert. What is left is what was actually asked for: settlement-density for the compact gritty block grid and npc-population for the NPCs walking the sidewalks; with no user to ask I kept every building a facade, which holds this on P0.
